title: TPA-limited high-Q ring
description: Nonlinear absorption capping a high-Q ring (models/optical_field/ring_nl.va): two identical loaded-Q ≈ 1.2e6 rings probed at 1 mW. The lower ring has beta_tpa = 0 (linear reference — deep 1.1 pm Lorentzian); the upper has silicon's TPA + free-carrier absorption of the ~100 mW circulating power, so its dip fills in and broadens ~6×. Above ~0.1 mW in the bus, TPA+FCA — not fabrication loss — sets the achievable Q. Try lowering the laser powers to 1e-6 W to recover matching lines, or re-enable n2_kerr = 4.5e-18 / dn_dn = -4e-27 to bend the hot line The pinned physics study is examples/ring_tpa_q.py.
